**About Zaza Promptly:**

Promptly is an AI-powered assistant designed specifically for teachers. Created by educators, for educators, it helps you:

• Write better parent communications in minutes
• Generate personalized student feedback
• Save 3-5 hours per week on admin tasks
• Maintain professional tone across all communications
• Support multilingual families with instant translation

**Who We Help:**

• **Primary Teachers:** Early years through elementary
• **Secondary Teachers:** Middle and high school educators
• **Special Education:** SEND coordinators and specialists
• **International Schools:** Multi-language support
• **School Leaders:** Administrators and coordinators

Used by 10,000+ teachers across 50+ countries.

**Quick Start Guide:**

1. **Sign up:** Create free account at zazapromptly.com
2. **Choose plan:** Start with free trial or pick annual plan
3. **Import students:** Upload class roster (optional)
4. **Start writing:** Use Comment Coach or Email Assistant
5. **Export results:** Download to Word/PDF or copy to clipboard
